mapper.sql: id, guild_kind AS guildKind, guild_id AS guildId, target_member_id AS targetMemberId, action_type AS actionType, CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE status END AS status, version, scope_type AS scopeType, scope_id AS scopeId, reason_code AS reasonCode, reason_text AS reasonText, duration_sec AS durationSec, delete_message_sec AS deleteMessageSec, starts_at AS startsAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, operator_id AS operatorId, request_id AS requestId, revoked_at AS revokedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_moderation_action(guild_kind, guild_id, target_member_id, action_type, status, version, scope_type, scope_id, reason_code, reason_text, duration_sec, delete_message_sec, starts_at, expires_at, operator_id, request_id) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{actionType}, #{status}, 1, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonText}, #{durationSec}, #{deleteMessageSec}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), IF(#{durationSec} > 0, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{durationSec} SECOND), NULL), #{operatorId}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_moderation_action WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM im_moderation_action WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_moderation_action SET status = 'REVOKED', version = version + 1, revoked_by = #{operatorId}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_moderation_action WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} AND target_member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND ((action_type = 'TIMEOUT' AND scope_type = 'CHANNEL' AND scope_id = #{channelId}) OR action_type = 'BAN')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_moderation_action WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} AND target_member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND action_type = 'BAN' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_message_mutation(conversation_id, message_id, version, kind, create_time) SELECT m.conversation_id, m.id, m.version + 1, 'RECALL', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM im_message m JOIN im_channel c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND c.guild_id = #{guildId} AND m.sender_id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND)
mapper.update: UPDATE im_message m JOIN im_channel c ON c.id = m.conversation_id SET m.status = 1, m.version = m.version + 1 WHERE c.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND c.guild_id = #{guildId} AND m.sender_id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND)
UPDATE play_team_member SET status = 2 WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 1
mapper.sql: id, action_id AS actionId, appellant_member_id AS appellantMemberId, guild_kind AS guildKind, guild_id AS guildId, status, reason_code AS reasonCode, reason_text AS reasonText, evidence_json AS evidenceJson, decision_reason AS decisionReason, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_moderation_appeal(action_id, appellant_member_id, guild_kind, guild_id, status, reason_code, reason_text, evidence_json) VALUES (#{actionId}, #{appellantMemberId}, #{guildKind}, #{guildId}, 'PENDING', #{reasonCode}, #{reasonText}, JSON_ARRAY())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_moderation_appeal WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM im_moderation_appeal WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM im_moderation_appeal WHERE action_id = #{actionId} AND appellant_member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE im_moderation_appeal SET evidence_json = JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(COALESCE(evidence_json, JSON_ARRAY()), '$', CAST(#{evidence} AS JSON)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','REVIEWING')
UPDATE im_moderation_appeal SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', decision_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','REVIEWING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_channel_report(reporter_member_id, target_type, target_id, channel_id, reason_code, reason_text, body_digest, audit_task_id, status, request_id) VALUES (#{reporterMemberId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{channelId}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonText}, #{bodyDigest}, #{auditTaskId}, 'PENDING', #{requestId})

SELECT pinned, hidden, muted FROM im_channel_member_state WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND member_id = #{memberId}

choose.when: INSERT INTO im_channel_member_state(channel_id, member_id, pinned) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{memberId}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pinned = VALUES(pinned)
INSERT INTO im_channel_member_state(channel_id, member_id, hidden) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{memberId}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hidden = VALUES(hidden)
INSERT INTO im_channel_member_state(channel_id, member_id, muted) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{memberId}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE muted = VALUES(muted)
